bio: Edelmira Patricia García (born 1984/1985) is an American political aide and political candidate who has served as the Chief of Staff for U.S. Representative Chuy García since 2023. She is the member-elect succeeding him after winning the 2026 United States House of Representatives elections in Illinois's 4th congressional district, though she has come under fire for a perceived undemocratic process by which she earned the nomination.
